issues.description: The solution defines the subroutine with the label ".set_pixel:" (leading dot) but the program calls set_pixel (no leading dot). The template provides a set_pixel: stub while the solution uses a differently named label. This name mismatch will prevent the call from resolving correctly (assembler/linker will not find the expected symbol), making the solution non-working and confusing students who compare template and solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the same symbol name in solution and template. Rename the solution label to set_pixel: (remove the leading dot) or change the call sites to call .set_pixel consistently and ensure symbol visibility (add a matching global directive if needed). This keeps the solution consistent with the template and the main routine.
